title: Publicly exposed asset is configured without authentication.
description: Publicly exposed asset is configured without authentication.
evidence: Supplied configuration identifies public exposure and no authentication.
remediation: Require appropriate authentication or document an approved, constrained public-access design.

title: Asset exposure is not established.
evidence: Input configuration sets exposure to unknown.
remediation: Confirm network reachability and document trust boundaries.

title: Dependency version is missing or not pinned.
description: Dependency version is missing or not pinned.
remediation: Resolve and pin an approved version; verify the lockfile and transitive dependency tree.

title: Observed API access behavior differs from the expected policy.
description: Observed API access behavior differs from the expected policy.
remediation: Verify the endpoint's authentication and authorization policy, correct enforcement, and add a regression test.

title: Recorded API outcome matches the declared expectation.
description: Recorded API outcome matches the declared expectation.
remediation: Retain the test as a regression check and validate coverage across protected endpoints.

title: API security behavior could not be verified.
description: API security behavior could not be verified.
remediation: Investigate the test error or execute the missing test and record the actual response.
